A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same Cumulative Reasoning work. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–F are readable and support reliable comparison despite extensive reflow.

before.justification: v8 reports original experiments on FOLIO-wiki, curated FOLIO-wiki, AutoTNLI, Game of 24, and MATH, including quantitative results in Tables 1–12.

after.justification: v9 retains these original experimental outcomes, including the Game of 24 trials and logical-inference and MATH evaluations. Appendix B separately identifies its additional comparisons as third-party reproductions.

M1.justification: The Proposer–Verifier–Reporter framework, cumulative DAG construction, Game of 24 search, and code-assisted MATH procedures are unchanged. Appendix F retains the same prompts.

E1.justification: Both versions retain FOLIO-wiki and its curated subset, AutoTNLI, Game of 24, and MATH. Appendix B's LogiQA, ProofWriter, FOLIO-val, and LD comparisons and the illustrative appendix scenarios also match.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within corresponding experiments: Direct, CoT, CoT-SC, and ToT where reported; Complex CoT with and without PHP for MATH without code; and PAL and ToRA for MATH with code.

E3.justification: Both retain 534/460 FOLIO-wiki examples, the first 1,000 AutoTNLI pairs, 100 Game of 24 puzzles, and 500-example MATH reproductions. Temperatures, prompt shot counts, search limits, and evaluation metrics are unchanged.

E4.justification: Table 5 retains the verifier and premise-selection ablations, and Table 7 retains the search-breadth analysis. The FraCas, FOLIO, MATH, and dataset-curation case studies in the appendices contain the same evidence.

E5.justification: Both Table 1 captions specify 1,000 repetitions per puzzle. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-reporting, confidence-interval, or significance-testing changes appear elsewhere.

E6.justification: All matched numerical entries and qualitative outputs are unchanged. Examples include CR's 98.04% curated FOLIO accuracy in Table 3, 98% Game of 24 accuracy in Table 7, and 72.2% code-assisted MATH accuracy in Tables 11–12.

T1.justification: Definition 3.1, Assumption 3.2, Lemma 3.3, Theorem 3.4, and Appendix A's proofs retain the same mathematical content. The logic definitions and higher-order formalizations also match.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contribution claims about cumulative verified reasoning and the same performance claims. Punctuation edits do not change their scope or strength.

C2.justification: The idealized verifier and monotonicity qualifications, explanations of DAG benefits, Appendix B.2's computational tradeoffs, and Appendix C's logic limitations are retained. Brief wording reductions do not alter their meaning.

D1.justification: v8's separate Website link is omitted in v9, while the same repository link is retained under Project Page. This is a limited access-information change; implementation settings and Appendix F's prompt templates remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including comparisons with CoT, ToT, graph-based reasoning, and self-critique frameworks in Section 5. No research citations are added or removed.

P1.justification: Small copy edits replace several em dashes, shorten two 'for the purpose of' phrases, and remove the project-lead designation and header acronym. The substantive paragraphs and section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: Document-wide retypesetting changes typography, paragraph and list spacing, front matter, and display placement. The shaded title/abstract panel disappears, Figure 3 moves ahead of the detailed theoretical comparison, and tables and boxed appendix examples are extensively redistributed. Their scientific contents remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v9 preserves the same methods, experimental evidence, mathematical arguments, and limitations. Its substantial retypesetting and small copy edits leave the material readable without materially changing clarity or evidential support. The repository link remains despite removal of the separate website link, so the revision produces no meaningful net quality difference.
